name: liquid-shape-morph
title: Liquid Shape Morph
description: A surface that morphs between organic blob shapes using animated border-radius interpolation across eight values — the cheapest real morph in CSS, with asymmetric timing so the blob never looks mechanical.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Pastel

## Rules

- Ambient Loop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
